<div class="card-body">
'''Houjix''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フージックス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：戦闘終了時に、そのロケーションに配備されていたカードをすべて没収して、なおかつダメージが残っていた場合、残ったダメージをすべてキャンセルする。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。２：「日没」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Houjix-SWCA-100665.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デジャリックに登場するホログラム・クリーチャー。凶暴な外見をした獣だが、性質はおとなしく、飼い主に忠実である。グランの出身星キニヤンではしばしば番犬がわりやペットとして飼われている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Houjix.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: At the end of battle, forfeit all cards that were deployed at that location. If damage remains, cancel all remaining damage. This interrupt is not affected by Sense.

2: Cancel Sunsdown.

'''Lore:'''
A hologram creature that appears in dejarik. The beast looks ferocious but is gentle and loyal to its owner. On Kinyen, homeworld of the Gran, they are often kept as watchdogs or pets.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese numbers the modes after どちらかを選ぶ and uses 戦闘終了時に plus forfeit-all as the first mode, not “if you just lost a battle and after.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Houjix]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
